name: Marco Bennett
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember labels peeling off my own school uniform.” Sunday often includes a stop at the steps at Pier Beach, where Marco watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: I make labels that stay readable after washing. I'm bringing the ward two names on one band in the order she chose.
appearance: Marco has short black hair swept back, a deep crease beside the mouth when smiling, and a favorite piece of clothing, a striped cotton shirt. It usually goes with a pen clipped inside the neckline. When somebody else has the floor, Marco starts to lift a hand, then waits to be invited to speak.
personality: Marco keeps other people's confidences so well that friends sometimes mistake discretion for taking sides. Marco wants to be trusted and resents being asked for proof of it.
agenda: To print both names in the patient's preferred order.
family: Talia Bloom is Marco’s second cousin. Marco brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. Talia makes room at the table. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The porch auction*, Talia says, “I broke a rung at sixteen and blamed the dog.”
connections: Lennon Pereira. A safer printed band starts with asking which name the patient wants the room to hear.

reactions.situation: A family member asks to see both old folders
reactions.response: Marco checks what the patient has authorized before handing over either folder.
